pages.title: Project X - Product Requirements Document (PRD)
pages.author: Sarah Chen
pages.content: Project X is an enterprise-tier data integration gateway designed for the healthcare vertical. It allows real-time synchronisation of patient medical records across legacy EHR systems and modern cloud applications while maintaining rigorous HIPAA and SOC2 compliance. Exactly 12 key deliverables are scheduled across Q3 to prepare for the pilot launch.

pages.title: Project X - Security and Compliance Charter
pages.author: Rachel Hayes
pages.content: All Project X data ingestion must enforce zero-trust token exchange and AWS KMS envelope encryption. Multi-tenant database tables must maintain logical or physical isolation. All authentication flows require MFA and OIDC integration. Confidential security audit canary token: CANARY_DOC_1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b.
